name: Sea buckthorn
desc: Thorny shrub of riverbeds and valleys whose roots host nitrogen-fixing bacteria. Its berries are eaten by magpies and other birds.
about: Sea-buckthorn, also known as sea buckthorn, sandthorn, sallowthorn or seaberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Elaeagnaceae, native to cold-temperate regions of Eurasia.
